name: crewassist-smoke
description: Browser smoke rig for CrewAssist: boots the real index.html in real Chromium (puppeteer-core + the sparticuz chromium build) and checks boot health, release stamps and the headline behaviours. Also carries the tailwindcss CLI used to rebuild the repo's compiled tw.css. node_modules is not persisted by the sandbox — run npm install after a workspace restore.
